; secondary-pen-toolbar: show the built-in "Secondary pen" in the toolbar,
; right after the primary pen.
;
; xochitl already has a second pen (own tool, colour and size, remembered per
; document), but it only shows when the toolbar's slot logic puts it in the main
; row. On small screens (Paper Pro Move) it always loses its slot and hides itself.
;
; The main editing tools come from a Repeater over xochitl's tool model, so nothing
; can be inserted between them directly. This wraps the Repeater's delegate: every
; tool is drawn exactly as before, and the delegate of the primary pen additionally
; loads one instance of xochitl's own SecondaryPenMenu right next to it.

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#toolbar > GridLayout#toolLayout > Repeater#editingTools
        REPLACE delegate WITH {
            delegate: GridLayout {
                id: editingToolSlot
                required property var model
                required property int index
                flow: toolLayout.flow
                rowSpacing: 0
                columnSpacing: 0
                visible: editingToolLoader.visible || pinnedSecondaryPenLoader.visible
                z: editingToolLoader.z

                ToolLoader {
                    id: editingToolLoader
                    model: editingToolSlot.model
                    objectName: "editingToolLoader_" + item?.objectName
                    buttonType: ToolbarTool.Type.ToolbarButton
                    toolbar: root
                    antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                    asynchronous: !root.visible
                    visible: shown && root.expanded
                    z: item?.totalHeight > root.height ? 1 : 0
                    onSelect: (tool) => root._select(tool)
                }

                Loader {
                    id: pinnedSecondaryPenLoader
                    active: editingToolSlot.model.tool === ToolbarModel.PrimaryPen
                    visible: active && root.expanded
                    sourceComponent: SecondaryPenMenu {
                        objectName: "pinnedSecondaryPenMenu"
                        toolbar: root
                        type: ToolbarTool.Type.ToolbarButton
                        group: ToolbarModel.Editing
                        antialiasing: root.antialiasing
                        onSelect: (tool) => root._select(tool)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
